question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Pretend
solution:
The correct answer is: **Feign**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pretend"** means to act as if something is true when it is not; to make believe or feign. (दिखावा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She pretended to be asleep when her mother checked on her.
 
 
 
• **"Feign"** refers to pretending or giving a false appearance of something. (बहाना करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He feigned illness to avoid going to school.
 
 
 
• Therefore, we can infer that the synonym of **'Pretend'** is **'Feign'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Feign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Benign** (सौम्य): Gentle and kind; not harmful.

 
 
• **Example:** The medicine had a benign effect on the patient.
 
 
 
• **Align** (संतुलित करना): To place or arrange things in a straight line or correct relative positions.
 
 
• **Example:** The engineer aligned the wheels to ensure the car moved straight.
 
 
 
• **Reign** (शासन): The period during which a sovereign rules.
 
 
• **Example:** Queen Victoria's reign lasted for 63 years.
